reviews.title: Mixed emotions
reviews.text: I love the concept of the bubble being multiple colors, i wish it was more like a specific emotion, even simple ones that you can put in it, as your overall day can’t be assumed right then and there unless you wait til the end of the day, which i struggle to remember and identify my own emotions by then. so, dropping the emotions in will not only make the bubble more colorful, but also be more accurate. another thing, the widget is nice, but i specifically would like my bubble to appear, and to be able to add the widget to my lock screen. it’d also be cool if there was a function to see your friends; not the specific emotions their feeling, but the color of their bubble. lastly, i do not like ai, but ive been desperate in trying to find a good mood tracking app. so i criticize it for using ai — to an extent. using ai to help better peoples understandings of themselves is commendable, better than stealing ideas and art of others. so, in conclusion: i love this app so far, but it could be so much better.

reviews.title: Like the idea but not renewing my subscription
reviews.text: I enjoy the app functionality and design but we need the ability to add our own custom moods and triggers. The current options put me in a box and I find it incredibly difficult to describe how I’m feeling and what made me feel that way with the options available. How am I supposed to track and improve my habits if I can’t remember what exactly I mean when I selected a certain trigger and chose not to write it in my notes?

reviews.title: Buggy, haven’t been able to log my moods consistently for about a week now
reviews.text: Every time I open the app I get a blurry view of the add mood screen. I don’t know if it’s because I recently turned off the Face ID encryption, or what. But I can sometimes start filling out the log, but then it remains blurred out, meaning I can’t see/read the buttons I’m selecting. I’m pretty disappointed, as I broke my daily streak of logging my daily moods since early February of this year this past week. I’ve had a stressful first full week back at school and really hoped to have been able to track my fluctuating moods as things came up on the daily. Needs massive improvement or bug fixes. I have noticed when it did still work, too, that it was very slow to respond and took several presses of buttons for it to select a mood, trigger, and take down my note/entry for the day. Considering moving forward with other more consistent alternatives now, tbh.

reviews.title: Love it but one huge problem
reviews.text: I really do love this app. For someone who finds it difficult to track anything or create any habit, this app helps a lot. The only big issue is that there is no “monthly overview” showing your mood states. You can see them weekly, but in the grand scheme of things, you want to see how your mood has shifted over the course of weeks. So a monthly view of your mood lights would really make this app perfect. Hopefully the app editors or creators see this and can implement this.

reviews.title: Keeps Crashing out
reviews.text: Its unfortunate, I use to use this app almost daily and was my favorite journal and mood tracker, it helped me in so many ways and I enjoyed that it can give feed back, I enjoyed all its features. However in these past months, this app has consistently crashed out or has been very slow at responding to tap demands. At first it wasn’t to much of a problem since it would just take a second or two, but it has gotten far worse and at times it will take me out of the app entirely and delete what I was writing. Also at the start of 2025 I was looking back through my history, trying to look for old notes from 2024, to find out it has been entirely wiped, it was heartbreaking, I didnt expect that at all. Its just saddening since I did love using this app and was one of the few mood/journaling apps that I checked regularly, now I dont even use it at all.
